behavior: lane status derives every one of the 9 phases from fixture facts, herdr absent included
verification: cd cli && o=$(mktemp) && go test ./internal/lane/ -run '^(TestDerive|TestStatus)$' -count=1 -v > "$o" 2>&1 && grep -q -- '^--- PASS: TestDerive ' "$o" && grep -q -- '^--- PASS: TestStatus ' "$o"

behavior: lane plan classes each action auto, pending (with due time) or ambiguous (with resolving command) and mutates nothing
verification: cd cli && o=$(mktemp) && go test ./internal/lane/ -run '^(TestPlan|TestPlanMutatesNothing)$' -count=1 -v > "$o" 2>&1 && grep -q -- '^--- PASS: TestPlan ' "$o" && grep -q -- '^--- PASS: TestPlanMutatesNothing ' "$o"

behavior: lane apply runs only auto actions via sweep and lane next, never adopt or land, and a second run reports changed=0
verification: cd cli && o=$(mktemp) && go test ./internal/lane/ -run '^(TestApply)$' -count=1 -v > "$o" 2>&1 && grep -q -- '^--- PASS: TestApply ' "$o"

behavior: a worktree with a live process or a recent session is never reaped by apply
verification: cd cli && o=$(mktemp) && go test ./internal/lane/ -run '^(TestApplyNeverReapsALiveWorktree)$' -count=1 -v > "$o" 2>&1 && grep -q -- '^--- PASS: TestApplyNeverReapsALiveWorktree ' "$o"
